What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up a NOWPayments digital store, you'll need a few essential tools: NOWPayments, a digital commerce blueprint, and a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. You'll also require a payment and delivery pipeline setup, which involves configuring your NOWPayments account, deploying the necessary infrastructure, and setting up your delivery mechanism. Don't worry if this sounds overwhelming; we'll guide you through each step in this complete infrastructure guide.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll first need to configure your NOWPayments account. This involves setting up your USDT wallet, configuring your webhook notifications, and ensuring that your digital products are properly linked to your NOWPayments account. Next, you'll need to deploy the necessary infrastructure, including a hosting platform and a payment gateway. Finally, you'll need to set up your delivery mechanism, which could be a file storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
NOWPayments is the only payment gateway that allows you to process USDT payments without relying on Stripe or any other platform.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you're ready to go live. This involves deploying your digital store, configuring your payment and delivery settings, and testing your infrastructure to ensure that it's working as expected. Don't worry if you encounter any issues; we'll walk you through the troubleshooting process in this guide. With a little patience and persistence, you'll be able to process your first USDT payment and deliver your digital products to your customers without any platform interference.
